scope: Local-file activation from empty site-search recents

reference.method: Normal Arc UI: open a temporary file, close its tab, then Cmd+T, YouTube, Tab, Return. The matching recent reopens the file.
reference.beforeZen: The same saved file was admitted but getLoadRequestFromResult returned engineSearch with its page title.
reference.cleanup: Temporary file visit removed through Arc History UI; comparison and History tabs closed; original video restored paused at 9:16. No Arc file/database edits or injection.

change: Permit file URLs alongside HTTP(S) for original-destination activation of this provider. Edited queries and other providers retain engine-search behavior.
